title: a hit whose records did not arrive is asked again
line: found means a hit's record or image arrived: a census household step whose search the 1950 site answers while the schedule and its image both time out holds no record, so the run is an error run, the step stays planned and runnable, no household member's step is logged, and the next run asks again and closes it once the schedule comes; an Archive directory step whose search names a book whose metadata times out is an error run too, its names logged unanswered, asked again until the metadata answers
